scope: Lượt 23 / Bước 89–92 — diagnostic planning and deterministic scoring; no mastery persistence, Priority Engine activation or production integration

rules: A passing diagnostic may skip redundant prerequisite review but never grants Master-ready.
Master-ready requires later exercise, lab/project, assessment and retention evidence.
A critical-item floor failure remains a gap even when the overall score passes.
No result is persisted before the Lượt 24 mastery/evidence contract passes.

reasonCodes.MISSING_VERIFIED_ITEM_BANK: No verified item bank is attached to this diagnostic plan.
reasonCodes.INVALID_ITEM_BANK: The item bank does not satisfy schema, target, count, difficulty or review gates.
reasonCodes.DYNAMIC_INSTANCE_REQUIRED: The dynamic Bauman subject needs a real syllabus instance before a diagnostic plan can be compiled.
reasonCodes.INCOMPLETE_ATTEMPT: Every verified diagnostic item must have exactly one valid response.
reasonCodes.CRITICAL_ITEM_FLOOR_NOT_MET: Critical-item accuracy is below the required floor.
reasonCodes.DIAGNOSTIC_PASS_NOT_MASTER_READY: A diagnostic pass verifies existing competency only and cannot grant Master-ready.
reasonCodes.MASTERY_PERSISTENCE_DISABLED: Diagnostic evidence is returned in memory only until Lượt 24 passes.
reasonCodes.PRODUCTION_DISCONNECTED: Diagnostic remains disconnected from production entrypoints.

abortConditions: consumer manifest or contract hash drift
missing diagnostic target or prerequisite reference
duplicate plan, item or response ID
unreviewed or generated item admitted as verified
item count or difficulty distribution mismatch
item bank contains no critical item
mastery, Priority Engine, scheduler or runtime write attempted
